_comment: Feature 130 -- dynamic framework version: ONE resolver, every reporting
surface (health, banner, dashboard, MCP serverInfo, CLI manifest) derives
from it, and the framework's own outbound HTTP client stamps it into a
User-Agent. See tina4-documentation/plan/v3/features/130-dynamic-version.md
and OWNER-DECISIONS.md Batch 5 (VERSION-DEC-01/02/03, DEC-03 RATIFIED).
GROUND TRUTH, NOT RE-BUMPED: this feature converges RESOLVERS onto the
manifest each repo already declares (pyproject.toml / App::$VERSION /
Tina4::VERSION+gemspec / package.json) -- it does not change the version
NUMBER anywhere. Ruby (`Tina4::VERSION` const, gemspec `require`s it) and
Python (`_resolve_version()`: pyproject -> importlib.metadata -> floor,
locked to pyproject by test_version_constant.py) were audited as the
reference resolvers and are UNCHANGED here.
VERSION-DEC-01 (single-resolver convergence, implemented in PHP + Node):
- PHP had THREE independent sources that drifted in a plain checkout:
App::$VERSION (the declared constant, correct), bin/tina4php's
tina4FrameworkVersion() (read composer.json's `version` key -- absent,
Packagist derives it from git tags -- then vendor/composer/installed.json
-- no self-entry, since in this repo Tina4 IS the project, not a
vendored dependency -- so it fell to the '0.0.0' floor), and the MCP
server's serverInfo (the constructor's generic '1.0.0' default, never
overridden at the one default-server call site). Fixed:
tina4FrameworkVersion() now reads \Tina4\App::$VERSION directly (an
autoloaded class DEFINITION, no App::start() side effects -- still
boot-free); the stale docblock claiming it 'mirrors
\Tina4\App::resolveVersion()' (a method that no longer exists) is
deleted. Tina4\Bootstrap\MCP.php's getDefaultServer() now passes
App::$VERSION as the third constructor argument.
- Node had ONE latent split: server.ts's readPackageVersion() was a
FIXED `../../../package.json` (three levels up) with no fallback --
correct in the monorepo dev tree, silently '0.0.0' the moment
@tina4/core is relocated (a published install, a pnpm store symlink)
because the fixed depth no longer lands on a package.json at all.
devAdmin.ts had its OWN two-fixed-path reader with the same floor, and
mcp.ts's default dev server never read a manifest at all (same
'1.0.0' constructor-default gap as PHP's). Fixed: ONE new module,
packages/core/src/version.ts, ports the CLI's own robust algorithm
(packages/cli/src/bin.ts readCliVersion() -- walk up from this file's
location to the NEAREST package.json declaring a version, not a fixed
depth) into @tina4/core. server.ts, devAdmin.ts, and mcp.ts's default
server all now import the SAME TINA4_VERSION constant from it -- three
readers collapse into one. (The CLI keeps its own small copy rather
than importing @tina4/core, which it deliberately avoids loading
eagerly so a bare `tina4nodejs --help` stays cheap -- both copies run
the identical walk-up.)
- AN UNDOCUMENTED FOURTH INSTANCE OF THE SAME BUG, found by direct
verification against the live source (not assumed correct from the
audit's 'Python/Ruby are the reference' framing): Python's and Ruby's
OWN default dev MCP servers had the identical gap PHP was audited for --
tina4_python/mcp/__init__.py _get_default_server() and
lib/tina4/mcp.rb Tina4._default_mcp_server both constructed
`McpServer(path, name=...)` with NO version argument, so BOTH also
reported the constructor's generic '1.0.0' default on serverInfo, not
__version__ / Tina4::VERSION. Fixed the same minimal way: the one
default-server call site in each now passes the resolved version
explicitly. The RESOLVERS themselves (_resolve_version(), VERSION in
version.rb) were not touched -- only this one unwired consumer, the
same class of bug already being fixed in PHP and Node. A user's own
custom McpServer(path, name) (no version arg) is unaffected in all
four -- that default stays '1.0.0' for app authors who have not set
their own tool-server version.
VERSION-DEC-02 (cross-source drift test, PHP + Node; Python/Ruby already
had this shape via test_version_constant.py / version_spec.rb -- this
fixture adds the SAME invariant, driven by the four case names below, to
all four so one shared JSON fixture covers every language uniformly).
VERSION-DEC-03 (RATIFIED, all four): a `Tina4/<version>` User-Agent is now
sent by the framework's own outbound HTTP client (tina4_python.api.Api,
Tina4\Api, Tina4::API, @tina4/core Api) by default -- a caller-supplied
User-Agent (constructor headers, add_headers/addHeaders, or a per-call
extra header) always wins; this is a default, never a clobber. Verified
absent before this feature in all four (VERSION-NO-UA).
PHP's `runtime_version_equals_the_package_manifest` case is special:
composer.json genuinely carries NO `version` key BY DESIGN (Packagist
derives it from git tags; App::$VERSION's own docblock explains why a
resolved read cannot work in the base Docker image). There is no separate
manifest file to diverge from -- the declared constant IS the manifest.
The PHP suite locks in BOTH shapes: if composer.json ever gains a version
key, it must equal App::$VERSION; today, absent-by-design is itself the
assertion.
Node's `no_surface_reports_a_placeholder_version` case carries an EXTRA
assertion beyond the other three languages: it builds @tina4/core, copies
dist/index.js + package.json into a fresh temp directory with NO monorepo
ancestor (one level of nesting, not the real three), imports the COPY, and
asserts the exported TINA4_VERSION is the real version, not '0.0.0' -- the
exact relocated-layout scenario the old fixed-depth-3 reader could not
survive.
NO MOCKS: every case boots a REAL server process (or, in Node, calls the
real startServer() in-process -- Node's own established convention, see
dual_port_contract.json), makes REAL HTTP requests (health GET, dashboard
GET, a real JSON-RPC POST to the MCP endpoint), spawns the REAL CLI
binary as a subprocess for the manifest case, and (DEC-03) boots a REAL
local TCP/HTTP capture server that the framework's OWN Api client makes a
REAL outbound request against.
Mutation-proved (2026-08-13): (a) reverting PHP's tina4FrameworkVersion()
to its old composer.json/installed.json read turns
no_surface_reports_a_placeholder_version AND every_reporting_surface_agrees
RED (the CLI manifest reports '0.0.0' in this checkout, disagreeing with
every other surface); (b) reverting Node's version.ts resolveFrameworkVersion()
to the old fixed-depth-3 read turns the relocated-layout assertion inside
no_surface_reports_a_placeholder_version RED ('0.0.0'); (c) stripping the
default User-Agent header from each Api client's request-building method
turns the_outbound_http_client_sends_a_tina4_version_user_agent RED (no
User-Agent header arrives at the capture server, or it does not start with
'Tina4/'). All three restored after confirming RED.
The four suites carry the SAME case names in each language's own idiom
(Python snake_case function, PHP testPascalCase method, Ruby it-
description, Node assert label), which
scripts/audit-contract-fixtures.py normalises and matches.
feature: 130 - Dynamic framework version (single resolver + version User-Agent)

invariants.rule: The resolved runtime framework version equals the package manifest version: Python __version__ == pyproject.toml [project].version; Ruby Tina4::VERSION == the loaded .gemspec's spec.version; Node the root/@tina4-core package.json version == TINA4_VERSION; PHP App::$VERSION is the declared single source (composer.json carries NO version key by design -- if one is ever added it must equal App::$VERSION, and this case locks in the absence today).
invariants.why: The version reported by every surface is only meaningful if it actually matches what got published/installed -- a resolver that agrees with itself but not with the manifest is just a different kind of drift.

invariants.rule: Booting a real server in debug mode and querying it for real, every reporting surface returns the SAME version string: GET /health (.version), the boot banner (captured from the real process's stdout log), the dev dashboard (GET /__dev/api/status), the MCP serverInfo (a real JSON-RPC 'initialize' POST to the mounted MCP endpoint), and the CLI manifest (a real subprocess running the framework's own CLI entrypoint with `commands --json`). No two surfaces may disagree.
invariants.why: This is the feature's whole point: a resolver nobody else reads is not a fix. Before VERSION-DEC-01, PHP disagreed with itself three ways in a plain checkout (App::$VERSION vs the CLI's 0.0.0 vs MCP's 1.0.0), and Python/Ruby's own default MCP server silently reported 1.0.0 despite an otherwise-correct resolver -- a real regression this case would have caught immediately.

invariants.rule: None of the real, live-queried surfaces (health, dashboard, MCP serverInfo, CLI manifest) ever returns the literal placeholder '0.0.0' or '1.0.0' -- the two sentinels this feature's audit found leaking through a plain checkout (PHP CLI/MCP) or a relocated install (Node). Node additionally builds the real @tina4/core package, copies it into a fresh temp directory with no monorepo ancestor, imports THAT copy, and asserts its resolved version is not '0.0.0' -- the exact scenario the old fixed-depth-3 reader could not survive.
invariants.why: A placeholder version is worse than a merely-wrong one: it looks like a real, well-formed semver and can silently pass a superficial 'is this a version string' check while actually meaning 'the resolver never found the real answer'. This is the negative control for version-every-surface-agrees -- a fix that made every surface agree by having them ALL report a wrong constant would still pass that case, but not this one.

invariants.rule: The framework's own outbound HTTP client (Api/API) sends a default `Tina4/<resolved version>` User-Agent header on a real outbound request to a real local capture server. A caller-supplied User-Agent (via the constructor's headers option, add_headers()/addHeaders(), or a per-call extra header) is preserved -- the default never clobbers an explicit value. Existing client behaviour (setIgnoreSsl/ignore_ssl, custom headers, timeouts, the send_request/sendRequest signature) is unaffected.
invariants.why: VERSION-DEC-03 (RATIFIED, owner-decided 2026-08-11): outbound version visibility, so a server the framework talks to can key off which Tina4 version is calling it -- verified ABSENT in all four before this feature (VERSION-NO-UA).
